title: 2003 AMC 10A Problem 22
statement: In rectangle \(ABCD,\) we have \(AB = 8,\) \(BC = 9,\) \(H\) is on \(\overline{BC}\) with \(BH = 6,\) \(E\) is on \(AD\) with \(DE = 4,\) line \(EC\) intersects line \(AH\) at \(G,\) and \(F\) is on line \(AD\) with \(\overline{GF} \perp \overline{AF}.\) Find the length \(\overline{GF}.\)

solutions.text:
Place \(D = (0, 0),\) \(A = (9, 0),\) \(B = (9, 8),\) \(C = (0, 8),\) \(H = (3, 8),\) and \(E = (4, 0).\)

Line \(AH\) has equation \(y = -\dfrac{4}{3}x + 12,\) and line \(EC\) has equation \(y = -2x + 8.\)

Setting them equal gives \(x = -6\) and \(y = 20,\) so \(G = (-6, 20).\) Since \(\overline{GF}\) is perpendicular to line \(AD\) (the \(x\)-axis), its length is the height \(20.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Place \(D\) at the origin with \(A\) on the positive \(x\)-axis
Find where line \(AH\) and line \(EC\) meet, then \(\overline{GF}\) is the height of \(G\) above line \(AD\)
